business.name: The Corner Table
business.description: The Corner Table is a relaxed neighbourhood restaurant serving wood-fired pizza, handmade pasta, grills, curries and Asian favourites, with a full bar, coffee and desserts. There is live music on weekends, a private dining room for groups, parking, and step-free access.

contact.address: 123 Example Street, Sample City, Sample State, 000000, India

data.body:
The Corner Table began as a small kitchen with a big table. Today it is a neighbourhood restaurant and bar where regulars and first-timers share wood-fired pizza, handmade pasta, grills, curries and a long list of drinks.

We cook from scratch, buy from nearby suppliers when we can, and keep the music live on weekends. There is a private dining room for groups, parking, and step-free access throughout.

entries.title: How do I book a table?
entries.body: Use Book a table on this site, or call us. For groups of nine or more, use the private dining form.

entries.title: What are your opening hours?
entries.body: We are open every day from 11:00 to 23:00. On Sundays we serve brunch from 10:00 to 15:30 and dinner from 18:00.

entries.title: Do you take walk-ins?
entries.body: Yes. Join the walk-in queue from your phone, or ask at the door.

entries.title: Is there parking?
entries.body: There is street parking nearby and a small car park behind the building.

entries.title: Is the restaurant wheelchair accessible?
entries.body: Yes. There is step-free access to every dining area. Tell us before you visit if you need anything else.

entries.title: Do you cater for dietary needs?
entries.body: Yes. The menu marks vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free dishes, and every allergen is listed. Tell your server about any allergy.

entries.title: Are children welcome?
entries.body: Very. We have high chairs, a smaller menu on request and colouring sheets.

entries.title: Do you have a private dining room?
entries.body: Yes, for up to twenty-four guests. It suits birthdays, family gatherings and corporate dinners.

entries.title: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
entries.body: Yes. Use Order online to choose pickup or delivery and see the fees before you pay.

entries.title: Can I buy a gift card?
entries.body: Yes. Gift cards are on the Gift cards page and arrive by email straight away.

entries.title: What is your cancellation policy?
entries.body: Cancel up to two hours before your booking at no charge. Later cancellations and no-shows may be recorded.

We are at 123 Example Street, Sample City. There is street parking nearby and a small car park behind the building.

Open every day, 11:00 to 23:00. Sunday: brunch 10:00 to 15:30, dinner 18:00 to 22:30.

entries.title: Maria Alvarez
entries.subtitle: Executive chef
entries.body: Trained in Lisbon and Lyon. Maria builds the menu around what the market has that week.

entries.title: Daniel Okafor
entries.subtitle: Sous chef

entries.title: Priya Raman
entries.subtitle: Head bartender

entries.title: Thomas Becker
